pitch:
Category: Animal.
Subject: songbird on a branch.
Style: Bauhaus primary-colour geometry.

requests.what: Two crisp white circular eye highlights, one on each black eye, with tiny CYAN glints offset below them. Keep them graphic and perfectly flat in the Bauhaus style.
A pair of tiny BLACK circular nostrils on the yellow upper beak, mirrored across the centre line. Add a short dark seam between the upper and lower jaws.
A large Bauhaus wing roundel: concentric RED, YELLOW and WHITE circles with a BLACK centre, placed on both blue wings and kept inside the existing red inset panels.
A bold geometric chest emblem: a small BLACK square behind a raised RED circle, with a thin YELLOW triangular pointer aimed upward. Keep the emblem centred on the white bib.
Three broad alternating YELLOW and RED bands crossing the blue tail feathers, aligned perpendicular to the tail direction. The bands should be simple flat slabs with strong diagonal Bauhaus spacing.
Matching BLACK and YELLOW ankle bands on both legs, made from two thin rectangular rings. Keep the feet and toes visible below the bands.
A small three-piece head crest in RED, BLUE and YELLOW, like three overlapping Bauhaus triangles. It rises from the crown without covering the eyes.
Three small geometric buds at the branch forks: faceted YELLOW diamonds with tiny BLUE bases. Keep them sparse and subordinate to the bird.
Angular BLACK cut marks and two short RED rings around the exposed branch ends. Use chunky graphic strokes rather than naturalistic bark.
Paint the red head with a restrained Bauhaus pattern: one large off-centre YELLOW circle over the rear cheek and a small BLUE rectangle near the crown. Leave the eye and beak areas clean.
Paint the yellow body with broad flat primary-colour geometry: a RED lower belly wedge, a BLUE rear quarter, and a few sharp WHITE separators. No gradients or organic mottling.
Paint both blue wings with a crisp RED diagonal stripe and a narrow YELLOW edge stripe that follows the existing angular silhouette.
Give the branch simple flat WOOD and WOOD_LIGHT polygonal facets with two or three dark angular grain marks. Keep the branch less saturated than the bird.
